title: The Forgotten Ember
author: Marguerite Dunmore
blurb: Kestrel Fairweather, a thief who steals memories, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
